# USA Copier Movers

> USA Copier Movers is an American-owned copier shipping and moving company based at 2208 Station Rd, North Chesterfield, VA 23234. It moves and ships copiers, multifunction printers (MFPs), printers and other office equipment for businesses, schools, dealers and leasing companies: lease returns, office relocations, dealer freight, liftgate and white glove delivery, and storage.

Service area: Richmond, Hampton Roads (Virginia Beach and Norfolk), Northern Virginia, Washington, DC and Baltimore directly, plus the rest of Virginia; copiers are shipped to and from all 50 states and internationally.

How to get a quote: request a free quote online at https://www.usacopiermovers.com/#quote or call (866) 216-7742. Pricing depends on distance, machine size and weight, crating and delivery requirements, so it is quoted per move.

Phone: (866) 216-7742
